name: Diogenes, Bishop of Amisus
bio: Diogenes, Bishop of Amisus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 6th century AD. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Cycle of Agathias, compiled in the sixth century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 613).

poems.title: Book VII, 613: On his nephew Diogenes
poems.author: Diogenes, Bishop of Amisus
poems.text: This monument of thy radiant youth, Diogenes, did thy Phrygian father erect to thee on the Euxine Sea—alas how far from thy home. ‘The decree of God brought thee here to die, a sorrow fore-doomed for me, thy father’s brother, who having laid thee out with my consecrated hand and with prayer, put thee to rest here beside the dancing-place of the — blest.
